data.name: SVAKA: Lost Legends
data.detailed_description:
We are currently in Early Development.
Features, visuals, and content are still evolving as we continue building the world of Maji.

Step into the city of Neo-Bandung, a place where modern life stands side by side with ancient spiritual forces.
Dark spirits known as Dzinis have begun appearing more frequently, threatening civilians and pushing local militias to their limits.

You play as Suaka, a young fighter searching for answers after his father mysteriously disappeared during a past conflict. What begins as a personal journey soon grows into something far greater by uncovering hidden truths about the war, the spirits, and the fragile balance protecting humanity.

Alongside trusted allies, you will explore dangerous districts, battle supernatural enemies, and make decisions that shape the future of the city.

The deeper you go, the clearer it becomes:

Some secrets were never meant to be uncovered.

Gameplay

  • Explore the City of Neo-Bandung
    Travel across diverse districts, from peaceful neighborhoods to dangerous spirit-infested zones. Discover hidden locations, side quests, and environmental storytelling throughout the city.

  • Party-Based Action RPG Combat
    Control multiple characters and switch between them seamlessly during battle using the Character Swap System.

  • Assist System for Tactical Combat
    Call in party members to perform support attacks or combo extensions in real time.

  • Combo-Driven Battle Mechanics
    Chain attacks together to build powerful combos. The higher your combo count, the greater your damage output and combat rewards.

  • Character Growth and Equipment
    Improve your party through skill upgrades, weapon enhancements, and new combat abilities as you progress through the story.

  • Collectibles and Rewards
    Gather artifact fragments and hidden items scattered across the world to unlock:

    • Additional story entries

    • Lore records

    • Character gallery content

    • Special bonuses

  • Story Choices That Matter
    Decisions you make during key moments will influence character relationships, mission outcomes, and the direction of the story.

Storyline

  • Follow Svaka and his companions on a journey to find their missing parents.

  • Learn more about the people and factions protecting the city, including The Militia.

  • Investigate the mysterious events surrounding The Reckoning, a past disaster that changed the world.

  • Encounter powerful Dzinis entities and uncover the truth behind their sudden resurgence.

  • Discover secrets hidden beneath the surface of Neo-Bandung.

  • Learn more about Suaka and His Companions.

  • Experience multiple endings based on your choices and actions.


    Early Development Notice

    This game is actively being developed.
    Content shown may change as development continues.

    We are committed to expanding the world, improving gameplay systems, and delivering a meaningful story experience.

    Community feedback will play an important role in shaping future updates.

data.short_description: Explore the mystical world of Maji in a story-driven action RPG. Team up with Suaka and his allies to rescue the innocent from the grip of the dark spirit Dzuna. Face powerful enemies, uncover hidden secrets, and embark on a dangerous journey to find Suaka’s missing father.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (ver.1909 or later)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-3330 / AMD Ryzen™3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 (VRAM 2GB) / AMD Radeon™ R7 260X (VRAM 2GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
